title: Mode Same Stack Split Drop
description: Fix Mode dock drag-drop: when dragging a tab within the same stack and dropping on left/right/top/bottom split zones, preview is correct but release leaves window in tab. applyModeDrop incorrectly no-ops when zone.stackPath === sourcePath for split kind.
summary: Fixed Mode dock drop: same-stack split zones (left/right/top/bottom) now call splitWithWindow on release instead of no-op. Added applyModeDrop unit test and export for coverage. All @semio-tech/ui-react tests pass (53).
